description: Payment attempt outcomes for the last 30 days, by method. Simulates the live payments dashboard. Rates are fractions (0.09 = 9%).

by_method.note: UPI failures are mostly bank-side timeouts; system retries (same attempt ID) recover most of them.
Typed-card failures are dominated by wrong number / expiry typos and 3-D Secure abandonment.
No online payment; failures show up downstream as refused deliveries instead (see fraud rules).

card_detail.note: PayOrbit benchmark: saved-token (tokenized) card charges fail on first attempt ~2.8% vs our 9.1% for typed cards — the core quantitative case for saved cards.
